definition.name: Exact alias validation and two-tenant provider startup

steps.name: Execute all three new controls and require exact successful names
steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, os, re
from pathlib import Path
from tools.owned_test_process import run_owned, ProcessFailure
output=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'activation-aliases';output.mkdir()
names={
    'config::tests::providers::scalar_aliases::activation_aliases_cannot_replace_limits_epoch_or_missing_registration',
    'config::tests::providers::scalar_aliases::activation_aliases_keep_original_configuration_and_exact_binding_scope',
    'standalone::start::tests::provider_startup::activation_aliases_publish_original_limits_to_two_tenants_and_reap'}
result=None
try:
    result=run_owned(['cargo','test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','--all-features',
        'activation_aliases_','--','--nocapture','--test-threads=1'],
        cwd=Path.cwd(),timeout=1320,maximum=2*1024*1024)
    (output/'cargo.log').write_bytes(result.output)
    found=re.findall(rb'^test ([a-zA-Z0-9_:]+) \.\.\. ok$',result.output,re.M)
    summary=re.findall(rb'^test result: ok\. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; [0-9]+ filtered out;',result.output,re.M)
    if result.returncode or not result.cleaned or len(found)!=3 or {n.decode() for n in found}!=names or len(summary)!=1:
        raise RuntimeError('activation-aliases-exact-cases-required')
    (output/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'passed','sourceRevision':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
        'cases':sorted(names),'processCleaned':result.cleaned,'crossTenantGuestQualification':False},indent=2)+'\n')
except ProcessFailure as error:
    if error.result is not None:(output/'cargo.log').write_bytes(error.result.output)
    raise
PY
